quest.title: Where the Treasure Dwells
quest.description: It seems that pirates have hidden treasure in the Golden Apple Archipelago and divided the clues up into four parts. Recover all the clues and find that treasure!

chapter.title: The Treasure of the Four Skerries

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon see! Hmm... This looks like it might be some kind of treasure map.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh! Paimon's never wrong when she's on the scent of treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, it seems like "Ako Domeki and company" were the ones who left this picture behind. Feels like we've heard that one before, y'know?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also, look at this! "The treasure is hidden..." See? There's treasure to be had, alright!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's keep reading... "... Was split into four parts..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So they split something into four parts, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But whatever the case, it says here that something was "placed amidst the reefs of the four large islands." That should refer to the reefs on the four islands of the Golden Apple Archipelago.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, isn't this one of those reefs?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hmm, that means there must be four clues...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And they should be close to the reefs on the four islands!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmmm, that's gotta refer to the four biggest ones in the archipelago, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's give the other three islands a shot and see what we can find!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that makes four clues gained...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Uhh, Paimon can't tell where this treasure is supposed to be hidden at all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What does this "radius" and "center" stuff mean, anyway?

choices.text: It just means that we need to use the circles as a reference...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, is that it? Then we just need to draw four circles on the map and... uh, actually, how long is a "large boat-length"?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's take reference from some ships we've seen before...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we could probably refer to the big ships we've seen in the harbor... Hmm...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Paimon draws four circles on the map as instructed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, there's our four circles now. So the treasure is where all four circles overlap, huh?

choices.text: They mean the center of the circles...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is the treasure left by Ako Domeki and his crew? Hmm... But could they really have left the treasure here of all places back then?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It seems kinda weird no matter how you look at it...

choices.text: Not to mention the mountains on Pudding Isle...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Didn't those only appear because of the machine? Could they really have hidden this treasure, then?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Perhaps the treasure itself wanted to be found...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y'know, you've got a point. Maybe the wish of those who buried the treasure, that someone should find it someday, was affected by the machine...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, whatever the case, it's ours now!

choices.text: Not to mention the Captain Night Raven on Twinning Isle...

talks.objective: Collect the four parts of the clues to the treasure
Find the place where the treasure is buried
Go to the place where the treasure is buried and claim it
